movement_profile.formation_and_space: Linear street procession or open festival square navigation.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso stabilizes and sways a 40 kg wooden-and-bamboo frame extending 10 to 12 feet high.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Strictly grounded movement due to carrying heavy 40 kg load.
movement_profile.partnering: Solo dancer inside frame; structural rotation among multiple male dancers over long durations.
movement_profile.posture: Upright load-bearing posture inside a vertical frame supported on shoulders.

signature_moves.description: Swaying the 10 to 12 foot bamboo giant frame from side to side while balancing it on shoulders.
signature_moves.name: Frame Sway

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid losing balance or sudden head tilts that could destabilize the heavy upper frame structure.

basic_steps: Position body underneath the central frame opening and raise the frame onto both shoulders.
Align eyes with the viewing portal in the lower section of the frame structure.
Execute basic forward procession steps while stabilizing the 40 kg frame load with upper body balance.
Rotate frame left and right using upper torso sway to animate the giant doll face for public spectators.
teaching.formation: Street procession carrying giant framework individual doll-suits.
teaching.level_notes: Requires significant physical endurance and upper-body load-bearing capability to balance structures up to 40 kg over long duration.
